key_catalyst: Brent crude surges above $100/bbl on escalating Middle East conflict, reviving inflation and rate-hike fears

These are novel escalations of familiar themes (oil spikes, tariff overhang, earnings fallout) that the market has not yet fully absorbed, as evidenced by the modest pre-market drop (-0.30%).
